title: Why City Birds Sing Higher
before: 闭上眼想一条马路的声音：它是高的还是低的？鸟叫呢？
如果鸟为了被听见而唱得更高，这个改变会不会有代价？先猜一个。
paras: A bird's song carries a message: this is my territory, and I am here. In a forest the message travels well. In a city, it has competition. The low rumble of traffic, the hum of air conditioners, the growl of a bus — all of this sits in the same low range where much of a bird's song lives. The noise does not stop the bird from singing, but it does make the song harder to hear.

Researchers call this masking. A signal is masked when another sound covers it, in the way a conversation is lost under a passing train. Birds cannot ask the city to be quiet, so they do the next best thing: they move their song away from the noise. Many urban birds now sing at a higher pitch than their rural relatives of the same species.

This shift is easy to measure and hard to explain. A higher note is not simply a better note. Low sound travels further and bends around walls; high sound is more direct and is blocked sooner. So a bird that raises its pitch to be heard over traffic may be giving up reach. Its song is clearer inside the street but weaker across the district.

There is a second cost, one that has nothing to do with sound. In many species, females read pitch as a sign of size. A large male usually sings lower. A male who raises his pitch to compete with engines may sound smaller than he is, and a smaller song can mean fewer mates. Studies on one common city bird have found exactly this tension: males in noisy areas sing higher, and their songs are less attractive to females.

Birds have other options. Some sing louder, which costs energy. Some sing earlier, before the traffic rises, which pushes the dawn chorus into the dark. Some change the shape of a note rather than its height, adding a quick rise or a sharp cut that stands out against a steady background. None of these comes free. Each takes energy, time, or attention away from something else.

What looks like adaptation, then, is closer to a bargain. The city does not make birds better singers. It makes them different singers, shaped by a pressure that never lets up. And because the change is written in sound, we can hear evolution happening — if we stop long enough to notice that the morning sounds a little higher than it used to.
after: 一句话主旨：这篇的核心是什么，两句话以内。
圈 3 个词：最挡路的，或者看着眼熟但说不准的。点一下就是圈了。
三句复述：一句概括、一句细节、一句你的判断（不是总结，是你同意不同意）。
今天计时读第一遍：从第一句到最后一句，中途不停，读多久？
note: 第三段有两个分号句：Low sound travels further and bends around walls; high sound is more direct and is blocked sooner. 分号两边是一组对照，别拆开逐字读，先看「低音 vs 高音」的差别，具体细节读完再回填。
